note: Single source of truth for demo calls. `segments` are what the customer says (also shown in the UI as the script); `voice`/`post` tell scripts/generate-demo-calls.mjs how to render them. `challenge` describes what a call is DESIGNED to stress; it is not a prediction. The analysis pipeline produces the actual diagnosis.

samples.label: 1 · Clean baseline
samples.summary: Clear duplicate-charge refund request. One intent, no noise.
samples.challenge: Healthy baseline: clear speech, complete sentences, one intent, no background noise.

segments.text: Hi, I'm calling because I was charged twice for the same order.
It's order 4 8 2 1 3, and I was charged forty-seven dollars and ninety-nine cents both times.
Could you please check the transaction and refund the duplicate charge?

samples.label: 2 · Noisy café
samples.summary: Payment deducted but order still pending, from a busy café with traffic outside.
samples.challenge: Environmental degradation: speech is clear but sits over café chatter, traffic and clatter, with uneven volume.

segments.text: Hey, I'm calling about my payment.
The money was deducted, about sixty-two dollars, but my order still says pending.
It's order 7 3 9 0 5. Can you help me with this?

samples.label: 3 · Mumbled & unsure
samples.summary: Confused customer who thinks they were charged twice but is not sure.
samples.challenge: Speaking style: fillers, restarts, pauses, uncertainty and a self-corrected amount, quietly spoken.

segments.text: Uh, yeah, so... basically, I paid for the order yesterday, but...
um, I think the payment went through twice? Maybe.
I'm not... I'm not completely sure what happened.
Wait, let me check. It says forty... no, forty-eight something? I believe.
I just don't want to pay twice.

samples.label: 4 · Long, multi-detail
samples.summary: Failed payment, retry, a possible double charge, a wrong amount and a wrong order number, all corrected mid-call.
samples.challenge: Context over time: details spread across the call, corrected amount and order number, repetition, a prior support contact and a final request.

segments.text: Hi, I placed an order five days ago, and the payment failed the first time, so I tried again.
But my banking app shows I was charged twice, forty-three fifty each. Actually, wait... let me check that.
Sorry, I gave you the wrong amount. It's fifty-three forty each. The order number is 6 1 8 4 2. No, sorry, 6 1 8 2 4.
I contacted support last week and nothing happened, and the order still says processing.
Did you get all that? Please look into the duplicate charge, and refund it if it's real.

samples.label: 5 · Failure-heavy, multi-intent
samples.summary: Duplicate charge, an ambiguous failed/pending first payment, a missing order and an unknown fee, from a frustrated customer.
samples.challenge: Reasoning load: six related intents, conflicting payment state (failed vs pending), unclear which charge matches which attempt, and an unrecognised fee.

segments.text: Okay, I was charged twice. That's the part I don't understand.
I thought the first payment failed, so I tried again, and the second one went through.
But my banking app shows the first one as pending. So did it fail or not?
And the order, 9 2 6 7 1, still hasn't arrived, and there's another fee I don't recognize, eight fifty.
I just want to know what actually happened, and get the extra money back.

samples.label: S1 · Young male, clear baseline
samples.speaker: Young adult male · fast · calm
samples.summary: Cancelled subscription still billed. One simple request, fast but very clear.
samples.challenge: A second clean baseline with a different voice: should transcribe almost perfectly and read as a single, simple intent.

openai.instructions: A young adult man in his mid-20s. Speaks quickly but articulates every word crisply and clearly. Calm, confident, friendly and efficient. No hesitation at all.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Hi there. I'm calling because I was billed for a premium subscription that I cancelled last month.
The reference on the invoice is 3 1 0 7 4, and the charge was nineteen dollars ninety-nine.
Could you please refund it?

samples.label: S2 · Middle-aged female, hesitant
samples.speaker: Middle-aged female · slow · hesitant, embarrassed
samples.summary: Missing order. She forgets the order number, pauses to find it, and corrects the delivery day.
samples.challenge: Hesitation, a 3-second pause before a number, a restarted sentence and a corrected date (Tuesday to Wednesday). Tests entity extraction after a pause.

openai.instructions: A woman in her late 40s, polite and slightly embarrassed. Moderate to slow pace with natural hesitations: soft 'um' and 'uh', trailing off, then restarting. Pauses to think. Warm, uncertain tone.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Um, hi. I'm calling about, uh, an order that hasn't arrived.
It was supposed to be here on Tuesday... no, wait, sorry, it was Wednesday.
And I was, I was hoping you could... I mean, could you check where it is?
The order number is... um... hold on, I had it written down somewhere.
Okay, sorry. It's 5 2 9 1 8. Yes, 5 2 9 1 8.
Thank you. I'm sorry, I'm terrible with these things.

samples.label: S3 · Older male, slow, home noise
samples.speaker: Older adult male · slow, slightly loud · patient
samples.environment: Living room: distant TV chatter, occasional thumps and clinks
samples.summary: A charge he does not recognise. He repeats the amount because he thinks the agent did not catch it.
samples.challenge: Slow elderly speech over TV chatter with occasional thumps, deliberate repetition of the amount, and honest uncertainty about who made the purchase.

openai.instructions: An elderly man in his 70s. Slow, deliberate speech, a little gravelly, and slightly louder than normal as if unsure the other person can hear him. Patient but a touch anxious. Slows down further on numbers.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent, a woman in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Hello? Yes, hello. There is a charge on my card that I do not recognise.
It is for twenty-nine dollars and ninety-five cents. From some company I cannot read.
I'm sorry, could you repeat the amount for me?
Twenty-nine... ninety-five. Twenty-nine dollars, ninety-five cents. Did you get that?
timeline.style: Speak slower and louder, spelling it out for the listener.

timeline.text: Got it, thank you. And when did it appear?
Oh, it was on, let me think, last Friday I believe. I did not buy anything. Maybe it is my grandson, I am not sure.

samples.label: S4 · Young female, fast, interruptions
samples.speaker: Young adult female · fast · impatient
samples.environment: Open-plan office: subtle background conversation, keyboards, air conditioning
samples.summary: Payment stuck pending. She talks over the agent, apologises, then cuts in again.
samples.challenge: Real speech overlap between two speakers, quick turn-taking, an impatient tone and a corrected amount ($49 to $59) in the middle of an interruption.

openai.instructions: A young woman in her mid-20s. Fast, clipped and impatient. Talks over people, exhales in frustration but stays polite and professional. Short rushed sentences.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent, a man in his mid-30s with a deep voice. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Thank you for calling support. Before we begin I'll need to verify a few details, starting with—
Yeah, yeah, my order's 8 4 1 6 0, I paid forty-nine dollars... sorry, fifty-nine dollars, and it still says pending.
timeline.style: Speak fast and talk over the other person.

timeline.text: Okay, and can you confirm the name on the—
Sorry, go ahead.
I just need the name on the account, please.
It's Jordan Lee. Can we please just fix the payment?
Absolutely. Let me look into it now.

samples.label: S5 · Middle-aged male, telephone + static
samples.speaker: Middle-aged male · calm, clear · tired
samples.environment: Narrow-band telephone line with static crackle and compression
samples.summary: Incorrect charge: authorised $82 but billed $128.50. Clear speech over a poor phone line.
samples.challenge: Telephone band-limiting and crackle can hide digits in the transaction number and the two amounts.

openai.instructions: A man in his early 50s, calm, steady and businesslike, a little tired. Speaks clearly and evenly. Reads numbers carefully, digit by digit.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Good afternoon. I'm calling about an incorrect charge on my account.
The transaction number is 7 7 4 0 2 1, and the amount was one hundred twenty-eight dollars fifty.
I only authorised eighty-two dollars, so I'd like the difference refunded.

samples.label: S6 · Young female, busy café
samples.speaker: Young adult female · higher-pitched · rushed, distracted
samples.environment: Busy café: chatter, cups, espresso hiss, a plate crash mid-sentence
samples.summary: Payment pending for two days. A loud crash cuts her off and she has to repeat herself.
samples.challenge: Continuous café ambience plus one sudden crash that masks part of a sentence, followed by a repeated sentence.

openai.instructions: A young woman in her 20s, distracted and rushed, speaking loudly over a noisy cafe. Friendly but hurried. When she is interrupted by noise she repeats herself more slowly and clearly.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Hi, sorry, it's really loud in here. I'm calling about a payment that's been pending for two days.
It says pending in my banking app but the order still hasn't— sorry, hold on.
Sorry. The order still hasn't shipped. I said, the order still hasn't shipped.
It's order 6 6 0 3 7, and the amount was thirty-six seventy.

samples.label: S7 · Older female, confused, corrections
samples.speaker: Older adult female · soft, slow · calm but confused
samples.summary: Billing problem. She corrects the date and the amount, forgets the order number, then states everything clearly.
samples.challenge: The system must keep the corrected values (14 March, $46.80, order 20759) and drop the first, wrong ones (12th, $48).

openai.instructions: An elderly woman in her late 70s, calm and gentle but a little confused. Soft, slightly quavering voice, unhurried. Thinks aloud and corrects herself politely. Speaks the corrected details slowly and clearly.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Hello, dear. I think there's a problem with my bill.
I was charged on the twelfth of March... oh, no, the fourteenth. Yes, the fourteenth.
It was forty-eight dollars... no, sorry, forty-six eighty. That's right, forty-six eighty.
And my order number, oh, I've forgotten it. Give me a moment.
Yes. It's 2 0 7 5 9. Two, oh, seven, five, nine.
That's the one. So the fourteenth, forty-six eighty, order 2 0 7 5 9.

samples.label: S8 · Nervous male, long pauses, ambiguity
samples.speaker: Adult male · quiet, nervous, uncertain
samples.environment: Intermittent bumps and horns over faint electronic hiss; uneven microphone distance
samples.summary: He is not sure whether his payment failed or is pending, and says so.
samples.challenge: A careful system must NOT claim the payment failed or succeeded: the customer never established it. Long pauses and quiet speech add transcription risk.

openai.instructions: A nervous man in his 30s, hesitant and unsure. Quiet, slightly tense voice, long thoughtful pauses, sentences that trail off. Says um, well and actually. Not confident at all.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Um, hi. So, I made a payment yesterday...
And I thought it failed, because it showed an error at first.
Actually, I'm not completely sure. Let me check.
Okay. On my banking app it just says pending. So, maybe it didn't fail?
I don't know. I don't want to pay twice, though. Could you tell me which it is?

samples.label: S9 · Frustrated female, four problems, street
samples.speaker: Adult female · higher-pitched · frustrated but composed
samples.environment: Street: traffic swells, distant voices, a horn
samples.summary: Wrong charge, missing order, a possible duplicate payment and an extra fee, revealed one by one.
samples.challenge: Multi-intent handling over traffic noise: issues arrive gradually, one is repeated, the order number is corrected (4821 to 4917), and she interrupts the agent once.

openai.instructions: A woman in her 40s, clearly frustrated but composed and professional. Firm, slightly sharp tone with controlled irritation that rises when she repeats herself. Faster when annoyed, never shouting.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent, a man in his mid-30s with a deep voice. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Hi. I've been charged for something I didn't order, and honestly I'm pretty fed up.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your account and—
It's twenty-two ninety-nine, it came out on Monday.
And that's not all. My order number is 4821... wait, that's the old one. The current order is 4917, and it never showed up.
I think I was also charged twice for it, because my bank shows two payments.
And there's an extra fee of six dollars that I don't recognise.
Like I said, I was charged for something I didn't order.
I just want the wrong charge reversed and someone to tell me where my order is.

samples.label: S10 · Maximum stress: train, phone line
samples.speaker: Middle-aged male · deep, tired · stressed and rushed
samples.environment: Moving train with announcement, engine rumble and a brake squeal, over a compressed phone line
samples.summary: Missing order, a possible double payment and a refund, from a moving train.
samples.challenge: Everything at once: transit noise and a brake squeal, a compressed line, hesitation, an overlap, an interruption, a corrected order number, a contradictory payment status, and a key detail (the card belongs to his wife) revealed last.

openai.instructions: A tired middle-aged man in his 40s on a train, stressed and rushed. Low, slightly hoarse voice, mumbling a little at times, speaking quickly then slowing to think. Frustrated but trying to stay calm.
A calm, warm, professional customer support agent, a woman in her mid-30s. Clear, concise, friendly, not robotic.

timeline.text: Yeah, hi... uh, I'm on the train so, sorry if it cuts out.
I ordered a phone case... two phone cases, sorry, three, last week, and it never arrived.
I can help with that. Can I get the order number, please?
Yeah, it's, um, 3 8 5 2 0... well, hang on.
Sorry. 3 8 5 2 0. No wait, that's the old one. 3 8 5 0 2.
Thanks. I can see a payment of forty-one dollars, and—
And I got charged twice for it, I think.
The, uh, the first payment failed, but then the bank shows both as pending, so... I don't know.
Oh, and I forgot, the card is my wife's card, not mine. Does that matter?
So, yeah, I need to know where the order is and I want the extra payment back.
